pdf_extraction_process: Cyclic peptides binding to protein targets - extraction from PNAS 2020 Excel file and other PDF sources

input_sources.selection_reason: Phage-displayed cyclic peptide library against TEV protease and HDAC8. Contains cyclic and linear peptide sequences with KD and IC50 values.
input_sources.expected_content: Table 1 with cyclic peptide sequences (CycTev1, CycTev2, CycH8a) and their linear counterparts with KD/IC50 values

input_sources.selection_reason: Dataset of 30 cyclic peptide-protein complexes from PDB, used for benchmarking docking protocols.
input_sources.expected_content: Tables S1 and S2 with PDB IDs, peptide sequences, and cyclization types for backbone and disulfide cyclic peptides
